data.title: Trump Tells Stockpiling Americans Not to Panic Over Microsoft, Apple and FAA Outages: '...Relax, Everything's Good'
data.description: Trump downplays recent U.S. outages affecting Microsoft, Apple and FAA systems, urging Americans to remain calm as lawmakers seek answers.

data.description: Elon Musk calls Starship’s successful catch a critical milestone for deep-space exploration and orbital AI.

data.title: Meta Halts Mark Zuckerberg’s New Share Issuance Plan Amid Investor Lawsuit Alleging CEO Pressured Board to Approve It
data.description: Meta halts Zuckerberg’s Class C share plan as investors sue, alleging he pressured the board to preserve control while cashing out.
